title: A year after a feature came out, its 'new' dots light up again
what: The update notes carry only a day and a month, never a year. The dots work out the year by picking the latest such day that is not after today. So on the same date next year, a feature from this year counts as one day old again. A member who never opened that Settings page gets its dots back on the tab, the Settings button and the row, for a feature that is a year old. Old features can also take the three dot places before real new ones.
expected: A feature is new only in the 30 days after it really came out; a year later it never carries a dot.
how_often: every year, from the date each feature came out, for members who never opened that page
fix_line: Give each update note its full date with the year, or stop dots for any version older than the last few

title: Once MettleUp Plus is on, a gym member's free month runs out while the gym is already giving them everything
what: The free month starts on the first day the paid plan is switched on, even for a member whose gym plan or staff role already gives them every feature. Its 30 days pass unseen. When that member later leaves the gym, or their gym plan ends, they have no free month left. A member who leaves the gym is then told 'Your free month has ended' about a month they never knew they had.
expected: The free month starts only when the member would otherwise lose the paid features, so every member really gets their 30 days, and the 'ended' message is about a month they used.
how_often: every gym member or staff person who later leaves the gym or lets the plan end, once Plus is switched on
fix_line: Start the free month only on the first day the member is not covered by a gym plan, staff role or purchase
